agentLiveView.maxColumns.description: Maximum number of agent editor columns.

agentLiveView.debounceMs.description: Wait after a file change before opening it.

agentLiveView.maxFileSizeKb.description: Ignore files larger than this value.

agentLiveView.excludeFolders.description: Exact directory names ignored anywhere in the workspace (not glob patterns). For pattern matching, use agentLiveView.excludeFiles.

agentLiveView.ignoreUnattributedWhenHook.description: When agent hooks are installed, ignore file changes that cannot be confidently associated with Claude. Default is false so no edits are missed.

agentLiveView.minViewMs.description: Minimum time to keep an edited file as the front tab before switching to another file in the same editor column. Other agent columns can update independently.

enumDescriptions: Only show files matching includeFiles, then apply exclusions.
Show all files except those matching excludeFiles and excludeFolders (legacy behaviour).
agentLiveView.filterMode.description: Choose whether Agent Live View starts with an allowlist or watches every file except exclusions. Exclusion rules always win.
agentLiveView.filterMode.markdownDescription: `includeOnly` (recommended) displays **only** paths matching `agentLiveView.includeFiles`; `excludeOnly` retains the earlier behaviour. `excludeFiles` and `excludeFolders` always take priority.

agentLiveView.includeFiles.description: Workspace-relative glob patterns for files to display in includeOnly mode. JSON is NOT included by default: add exact JSON files such as **/package.json or a narrow folder glob such as config/*.json. Supports *, ** and ?. Exclusions still override matching includes.
agentLiveView.includeFiles.markdownDescription: **Allowlist:** Only files matching these glob patterns can appear when `filterMode` is `includeOnly`. JSON is not included by default. Add just the JSON files you care about, e.g. `**/package.json`, `**/composer.json`, `config/important.json`. Continue to use `excludeFiles` for scratch, generated and other unwanted files. **Exclusions win** if a path matches both lists.

agentLiveView.excludeFiles.description: Glob patterns (relative to each workspace folder) for files and folders Agent Live View should never open. Use **/*.log for all log files, **/traces/** for trace directories, **/scratch* for temporary scratch files. Supports *, ** and ?. Settings can be changed without restarting VS Code. Does not change what Claude edits or what appears in Explorer.
agentLiveView.excludeFiles.markdownDescription: Glob patterns for files and directories to **exclude from Agent Live View only**. Examples: `**/*.log`, `**/*.trace`, `**/cache/**`, `**/scratch*/**`. Paths are relative to each workspace folder; patterns without `/` match filenames anywhere. Supports `*`, `**`, `?`. Changing patterns does not prevent Claude from writing files or hide files in Explorer. Normal tests such as `src/product.test.ts` remain visible by default.
